//: outputDirectory is pinned to the repo root on purpose. This project was imported when the repo held only assets and config, so Vercel detected no framework and locked in `public` as the output directory. That made it serve public/_headers and 404 everything else. Settings in this file override the dashboard, so this keeps the fix in version control rather than in someone's UI session.

headers.value: noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, noimageindex, notranslate, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:none, max-video-preview:-1
